jsonld.name: Marketing for Colleges and Education Brands in India | MMC
jsonld.description: MMC runs lead generation, CRM and Meta CAPI tracking, retention funnels and reputation management for colleges and education brands in India.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the work of reaching students and parents, turning their interest into enquiries, and following those up until they enrol. The measure that matters is the cost of an enrolment, not the number of clicks or enquiries.

mainEntity.name: How do CRM and Meta CAPI improve lead quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: An enquiry form only tells Meta that someone showed interest. When your enquiries sit in a CRM, we send what happened next (contacted, applied, admitted, enrolled) back to Meta through the Conversions API (CAPI). Meta then learns which families actually apply and finds more of them, instead of optimising for the cheapest enquiry.

mainEntity.name: What are retention funnels in education?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structured follow-up sequences over WhatsApp, email and calls that guide an enquiry through application and enrolment, and bring back the ones who went quiet. Most enquiries are not ready on day one, so the follow-up decides how many enrol.

mainEntity.name: What is ORM and why does it matter for a college?

acceptedAnswer.text: ORM is online reputation management. Parents and students check ratings, reviews and social posts before they apply. We help you collect reviews, reply to them and keep the picture families find trustworthy.

mainEntity.name: What does MMC do for colleges and education brands?

acceptedAnswer.text: Websites, creative, social and lead generation, with a CRM and Meta CAPI set up so lead quality can be judged, retention funnels to nurture enquiries, and reputation management. The tags on this page show what we run for some of the brands we work with.
On the cost of a qualified enquiry, an application and an enrolment, and on how quickly enquiries get a reply. Admissions decides what counts as a good enquiry.

mainEntity.name: Do you only work with education brands?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We also work with D2C brands and B2B companies. Tell us what you run and we will say which approach fits.
It depends on scope and, for media, on ad spend, so we quote after the audit call, once we have seen your accounts.

hub.sub: Lead generation, retention funnels and reputation management that turn a parent's search into an enquiry, and an enquiry into an enrolment.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: Education marketing wins enquiries from students and parents, then turns them into enrolments. More than one person makes the decision, and there is often a deadline, so speed and clarity matter.
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) builds websites, creative and lead generation for colleges and education brands in India.

points.title: Connect the enquiry
points.text: Enquiries go to a CRM and Meta's Conversions API (CAPI), so campaigns learn from real applicants.

points.title: Nurture to enrolment

points.title: Measure the enrolment
points.text: The work is measured by the cost of an enrolment.

answer.chip: Measured by cost of an enrolment

leaks.h2a: Seven places a family slips away.
leaks.lede: An admission is a considered decision with a deadline. Each stage below is a moment where a family can leave, and the service that keeps them.

stages.breaks: Parents research on their phones long before anyone calls you.
stages.why: A course decision is made over weeks, and a parent compares colleges before they ever enquire. If you are not on the first screen for your course and city, you are not in the comparison.
stages.does: We run search and paid campaigns around the courses, cities and intakes families search for, and build the SEO that keeps you visible between intakes.

stages.breaks: The page a parent lands on hides the answers.
stages.why: Fees, eligibility, placements and campus life decide the shortlist. When they sit behind a brochure download, families leave for the college that shows them.
stages.does: We build course pages that answer those questions in plain words, load fast on a phone and lead to one clear next step.

stages.breaks: The enquiry form asks too much of a parent on a phone.
stages.why: Most enquiries start on a small screen, often in the evening. Every extra field costs you a family who was already interested.
stages.does: We design short, mobile-first forms and course-specific landing pages, and test them so more of the visitors you pay for become enquiries.

stages.tag: Lead generation, CRM and Meta CAPI
stages.breaks: The ad platform is told a form was filled, so it finds cheap fills.
stages.why: A form fill is not an applicant. Optimised on fills, Meta brings volume that admissions cannot convert, and counsellors spend intake season on families who were never going to apply.
stages.does: We connect your enquiries to a CRM and send the applied and enrolled stages back to Meta through the Conversions API (CAPI), so campaigns learn from real applicants.

stages.why: Most families are not ready on day one. The college that follows up sensibly, at the right moments before the deadline, is the one they remember.
stages.does: We build retention funnels of WhatsApp, email and call reminders around your intake calendar, to guide each family to apply and to win back the quiet ones.

stages.why: Before applying, parents read what students and other parents wrote. A low rating with no reply, or no reviews at all, raises doubt at the last step.
stages.does: We encourage genuine reviews, reply to them, and keep the profile families see on Google and review sites accurate and credible.

stages.breaks: Nobody can say which campaign produced a seat.
stages.why: Without ad-to-enrolment tracking, budget follows clicks instead of admissions, and your strongest channel looks the same as your weakest.
stages.does: We track each family from ad to enquiry to enrolment in your CRM, so spend is judged on the cost of an enrolment, not on clicks.

with.d: The platform sees which enquiries applied and which enrolled. Spend moves toward those families, and the cost of an enrolment becomes the number to watch.
